verdict.rationale: Channel3 says agents that support UCP can connect to its catalog for product search and lookup, and its REST API is versioned (/v1/) with a consistent product schema across retailers. That gives developers a protocol-style integration point, but only a thin one: probes found no published OpenAPI or JSON schema, and nothing in the evidence describes conformance or validation tooling. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable schema/spec, conformance or validation tooling, documentation of protocol versioning beyond the v1 path, and independent corroboration of the UCP integration.
